nodes.title: Help❓
widgets_values:
🔹 This group lets you inpaint with a cropped/full context area.
🔹 Select 'true' to crop the context area (✂️) or 'false' to use the full image (🌎).
🔹 Select 'true' to draw a context mask (🗺️) to grow the context area (🧿).
🔹 Prompt (3️⃣) should focus on the context area (🧿) ie. what the model sees.
🔹 Run to populate the mask nodes (4️⃣), they can stop execution if no mask.
🔹 An inpainting model (1️⃣) is recommended for best results.
